This resin is found chiefly in semi-arid climates, especially in coniferous forests, and is best known in southern Endor.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains fairly easy to find.

To obtain its properties, it is used by direct application.

The tree yields a resin called Harfy that immediately stops almost any bleeding. Kept in an airtight container, it retains its properties for one year.

Repeated use can lead to habituation.
